$comment: Mutation definitions for spec 008 T009b (deletion convergence model).
Same standard as tool/mutations/008_t009_convergence.json: each row
reverts one rule of the T009b deletion model and the runner asserts at
least one test that checks an OUTCOME dies. TARGET IS A TEST FILE,
DELIBERATELY — the model under mutation lives inside
mergeDeletionDocs). Every `find` below is model code, never an `expect`.

mutations.title: tombstone join carries the OLDEST deletion clock (max -> min)
mutations.property: FR-5: tombstoned both sides preserves the NEWEST supported deletion data; min is also a semilattice, so only an outcome test on divergent clocks can see it (T009's M1a lesson)

mutations.property: the tombstone join must be commutative; keeping the first operand is 'prefer local' relocated into the deletion evidence — defect C4's class

mutations.property: FR-4: a missing side is an automatic union, never a deletion; if absence annihilates, every one-sided record is silently dropped by the next merge
